name: Riverside Youth Court Volunteers
what_you_do: Help run a court where teens decide the outcome for first-time youth offenders. You can be a juror, attorney, advocate or court clerk. An adult judge is in charge.
who_can_apply: You must be 12 to 17 with no criminal record. You must live, work or go to school in the City of Riverside.
duration: Twice a month on Wednesdays, 5:00 to 9:00 p.m., at the Riverside Hall of Justice
deadline_text: No deadline. You must go to a juror training first. No training dates are listed as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Go to a required juror training first. Watch the police department social media for dates. Or call Officer E. Murphy at 951-826-5573 or CSO A. Guerra at 951-826-5147.
notes: If you live far away or cannot come twice a month, the page points you to the California Courts map of youth courts.
